snippet.title: Doomdark's Revenge - 1985 - C64
snippet.description: I play Doomdark's Revenge the first time, I like the premise of the game and the graphics are simple yet I think  there is a certain aura that the game radiates. Additionally,  the controls are fairly simple, it is the mechanics which take some time to figure out.
